description: This file contains an abstract class 'PlacementFilterStrategy' which defines the interface and partial implementation for strategies used to filter silos for grain placement in Orleans. It includes methods for initialization, property population, and retrieving placement filter properties, indicating its role in placement strategy customization.

classes.name: PlacementFilterStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class defining strategy for filtering silos on which grains can be placed. It includes order handling, initialization with grain properties, and population of grain properties for placement decisions.

methods.name: PlacementFilterStrategy
methods.description: Constructor initializing the strategy's execution order.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with grain properties, including parsing the order property.

methods.name: AdditionalInitialize
methods.description: Virtual method for additional initialization, can be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: PopulateGrainProperties
methods.description: Populates grain properties to reflect the placement filter strategy and its order, as well as any additional properties from subclasses.

methods.name: GetPlacementFilterGrainProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific placement filter property value for the strategy from grain properties.

methods.name: GetAdditionalGrainProperties
methods.description: Virtual method to supply extra grain properties specific to subclasses, given existing context.
